name: All Damage
description: All damage +8% per stack (maximum 3).
short_description: All damage is 8% higher for each stack, up to three stacks.

name: Reinforced Plates
description: Gain 8 armor at the start of each stage per stack.
short_description: At each stage start, gain 8 armor for each stack.

name: Field Supplies
description: Gain 2 kits at the start of each stage per stack.
short_description: At each stage start, gain 2 kits for each stack.

name: Scavenger
description: Gold income +12% per stack.
short_description: Gold income is 12% higher for each stack.

name: Ammo Reserve
description: Restore 15% ammunition at the start of each stage per stack.
short_description: At each stage start, restore 15% ammunition for each stack.

name: First Aid
description: Health and armor recovery +20% per stack.
short_description: Health and armor recovery is 20% higher for each stack.

name: Quick Hands
description: Weapon attack cooldown -8% per stack (maximum -30%).
short_description: Weapon attacks recharge 8% faster for each stack, up to 30%.

name: Finisher
description: Deal +20% damage per stack to enemies below 30% health.
short_description: Deal 20% more damage per stack to enemies below 30% health.

name: Boss Hunter
description: Deal +25% damage to bosses.
short_description: Deal 25% more damage to bosses.

name: Kill Chain
description: Kills briefly grant +4% damage, stacking up to five times.
short_description: Kills briefly grant 4% more damage, up to five times.

name: Glass Edge
description: Deal +35% damage, but take +20% damage.
short_description: Deal 35% more damage, but take 20% more damage.

name: Damage Dampener
description: Damage taken -8% per stack (total reduction capped at 50%).
short_description: Take 8% less damage for each stack, up to 50%.

name: Emergency Plating
description: Dropping below 35% health grants 15 armor once per stage.
short_description: Below 35% health, gain 15 armor once each stage.

name: Guardian
description: Allies near you take 12% less damage.
short_description: Nearby allies take 12% less damage.

name: Last Stand
description: Once per stage, survive lethal damage with 1 health.
short_description: Once each stage, survive lethal damage with 1 health.

name: Quartermaster
description: Shop prices -10% per stack (maximum -40%).
short_description: Shop prices are 10% lower for each stack, up to 40%.

name: Premium Stock
description: Shops offer one additional high-tier item.
short_description: Shops offer one additional high-tier item.

name: Engineer
description: Building costs -20% and repairs +25%.
short_description: Buildings cost 20% less and repairs restore 25% more.

name: Recycler
description: Destroyed friendly buildings refund 40% of their kit cost.
short_description: Destroyed friendly buildings refund 40% of their kit cost.

name: Firearm Damage
description: Firearm damage +12% per stack.
short_description: Firearm damage is 12% higher for each stack.

name: Sustained Fire
description: Continuous firearm hits build up to +25% damage.
short_description: Continuous firearm hits build up to 25% more damage.

name: Gunslinger
description: Firearms reload 20% faster and gain improved handling.
short_description: Firearms reload 20% faster and handle more smoothly.

name: Explosive Damage
description: Explosive damage +12% per stack.
short_description: Explosive damage is 12% higher for each stack.

name: Wide Blast
description: Explosion radius +25% (maximum +50%).
short_description: Explosion radius is 25% larger, up to 50%.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Explosive kills have a chance to trigger a secondary blast.
short_description: Explosive kills can trigger a secondary blast.

name: Electric Damage
description: Electric damage +12% per stack.
short_description: Electric damage is 12% higher for each stack.

name: Arc Conductor
description: Electric hits arc to one nearby enemy for 35% damage.
short_description: Electric hits arc to one nearby enemy for 35% damage.

name: Capacitor
description: Every fifth electric hit deals double damage.
short_description: Every fifth electric hit deals double damage.

name: Melee Damage
description: Melee damage +12% per stack.
short_description: Melee damage is 12% higher for each stack.

name: Blood Drive
description: Melee kills restore 4 health.
short_description: Melee kills restore 4 health.

name: Shockwave
description: Heavy melee hits release a damaging shockwave.
short_description: Heavy melee hits release a damaging shockwave.

name: Delver
description: Invasion stage-start supplies +25% per stack.
short_description: Invasion stage-start supplies are 25% higher for each stack.

name: Objective Specialist
description: Deal +20% damage to Invasion objective targets.
short_description: Deal 20% more damage to Invasion objectives.

name: Adaptation
description: After each Invasion floor, gain 4% damage for the run.
short_description: After each Invasion floor, gain 4% more damage for the run.

name: Breathing Room
description: Horde intermissions restore 20% health and ammunition per stack.
short_description: Horde breaks restore 20% health and ammunition for each stack.

name: Reaper
description: Horde multikills grant +15% damage for 5 seconds.
short_description: Horde multikills grant 15% more damage for 5 seconds.

name: Siege Master
description: Buildings deal +30% damage during Horde.
short_description: Buildings deal 30% more damage during Horde.

name: Saboteur
description: Extraction switch and objective interactions are 25% faster per stack.
short_description: Extraction interactions are 25% faster for each stack.

name: Escape Artist
description: Gain +15% movement speed while evacuating.
short_description: Move 15% faster while evacuating.

name: No One Left
description: Reviving an ally grants both players 20 armor.
short_description: Reviving an ally grants both players 20 armor.

name: Marking Rounds
description: Six direct hits on one enemy apply Vulnerable for 4 seconds; each stack adds 3% damage taken, capped at 25%.
short_description: Six direct hits apply Vulnerable for 4 seconds. Each stack adds 3% damage.

name: Barrier Cell
description: Gain 6 Barrier per stack at stage start. Barrier absorbs damage before armor and is capped at 30.
short_description: At stage start, gain 6 Barrier per stack, up to 30.

name: Second Wind
description: Every 5 kills restores 2 health per stack, up to three triggers per stage.
short_description: Every 5 kills restore 2 health per stack, up to three times each stage.

name: Salvage Instinct
description: Every 8 kills grants 1 kit per stack, capped at 6 kits per stage.
short_description: Every 8 kills grant 1 kit per stack, up to 6 kits each stage.

name: Reserve Fund
description: Stage completion pays 5% interest on current gold per stack, capped at 30 gold per stage.
short_description: Stage completion pays 5% interest per stack, up to 30 gold.

name: Field Relay
description: Allies within 350 range receive 6% more health, armor and Barrier recovery per stack.
short_description: Nearby allies receive 6% more recovery for each stack.

name: Drone Chassis
description: Deploy a support drone; each stack increases current module efficiency by 10%, capped at 30%.
short_description: Deploy a support drone. Each stack improves its module efficiency by 10%.

name: Bonus Shot Damage
description: Firearm hits build Focus. At 10, the next shot consumes it for +15% damage per stack.
short_description: Every 10 firearm hits, the next shot deals 15% more damage per stack.

name: Bonus Blast Damage
description: Explosions gain one charge per enemy hit. At 5, the next blast consumes five for +8% damage per stack.
short_description: Every 5 enemy hits, the next blast deals 8% more damage per stack.

name: Extra Chain Target
description: Electric hits gain Voltage. At 10, the next hit consumes it and arcs to one extra target per stack.
short_description: Every 10 electric hits, the next hit chains to one extra target per stack.

name: Bonus Melee Damage
description: Melee hits gain Fury. At 10, the next melee hit consumes it for +20% damage per stack.
short_description: Every 10 melee hits, the next hit deals 20% more damage per stack.

name: Objective Cache
description: The first objective completed each stage restores 10% ammo and grants 3 armor per stack.
short_description: The first objective each stage restores 10% ammo and grants 3 armor per stack.

name: Predator
description: Deal +15% damage to Vulnerable targets.
short_description: Deal 15% more damage to Vulnerable targets.

name: Apex Execution
description: Every 10th direct hit deals +75% damage and refreshes Vulnerable.
short_description: Every tenth direct hit deals 75% more damage and refreshes Vulnerable.

name: Barrier Refit
description: After 5 seconds without taking damage, restore 2 Barrier each second.
short_description: After 5 seconds unharmed, restore 2 Barrier each second.

name: Barrier Break Armor
description: When Barrier breaks, gain 15 armor once per stage.
short_description: When Barrier breaks, gain 15 armor once each stage.

name: Liquid Assets
description: Gain +2% damage per 50 gold held, capped at +20%.
short_description: Gain 2% more damage per 50 gold held, up to 20%.

name: War Economy
description: Every 25 gold spent grants 5 Barrier, up to 15 Barrier per purchase.
short_description: Every 25 gold spent grants 5 Barrier, up to 15 per purchase.

name: Servo Link
description: Drone attack and repair intervals are 8% shorter per stack, subject to the 30% cooldown cap.
short_description: Drone attack and repair intervals are 8% shorter per stack, up to 30%.

name: Assault Module
description: Drone attacks the nearest enemy every 1.2 seconds for 20% of current weapon base damage.
short_description: The drone attacks every 1.2 seconds for 20% weapon damage.

name: Guardian Module
description: Drone gives allies within 280 range 10% damage reduction.
short_description: The drone makes nearby allies take 10% less damage.

name: Repair Module
description: Each second, restore 2 armor or durability to the lowest-armored ally or friendly building.
short_description: The drone restores 2 armor or durability each second.

name: Coordinated Firmware
description: Increase current drone module efficiency by 25%.
short_description: Current drone module efficiency is 25% higher.

name: Autonomous Core
description: Increase current module efficiency by another 50%; a disabled drone recovers after 5 seconds.
short_description: Current drone module efficiency is 50% higher. Disabled drones recover after 5 seconds.

name: Calibration
description: Reduce the Focus trigger threshold by 1 per stack, to a minimum of 7.
short_description: Focus needs 1 fewer hit per stack, to a minimum of 7.

name: Pinpoint Burst
description: Consuming Focus applies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.
short_description: Consuming Focus applies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

name: Perfect Sequence
description: After consuming Focus, the first 6 shots of the next magazine deal +35% damage.
short_description: After consuming Focus, the next magazine's first 6 shots deal 35% more damage.

name: Armor Piercer
description: Deal +8% firearm damage to Vulnerable targets per stack.
short_description: Deal 8% more firearm damage per stack to Vulnerable targets.

name: Tactical Reload
description: After a full reload, the first 5 shots deal +15% damage.
short_description: After a full reload, the first 5 shots deal 15% more damage.

name: Crossfire
description: Against the assault drone's target, player damage is +15% and drone damage is +50%.
short_description: Against the assault drone target, players deal 15% more damage and the drone 50% more.

name: Packed Charge
description: Reduce the empowered blast threshold by 1 per stack, to a minimum of 3.
short_description: Empowered blasts need 1 fewer hit per stack, to a minimum of 3.

name: Breach Charge
description: Empowered explosions apply Vulnerable for 5 seconds.
short_description: Empowered explosions apply Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

name: Cataclysm
description: Every 3rd empowered explosion creates a delayed secondary explosion for 60% damage.
short_description: Every third empowered explosion creates a delayed blast for 60% damage.

name: Shrapnel
description: Empowered explosions apply 1 Bleed stack per card stack.
short_description: Empowered explosions apply 1 Bleed stack for each card stack.

name: Controlled Fuse
description: Take 50% less self-explosion damage; empowered blast radius is 20% larger.
short_description: Take 50% less self-explosion damage. Empowered blasts have 20% more radius.

name: Siege Payload
description: Deal +30% explosive damage to bosses, objectives and buildings.
short_description: Deal 30% more explosive damage to bosses, objectives, and buildings.

name: Charge Coil
description: Gain 1 extra Voltage per stack when charging, up to 3 Voltage per hit.
short_description: Gain 1 extra Voltage per stack when charging, up to 3 per hit.

name: Conductive
description: Consuming Voltage makes the target Conductive for 5 seconds; later arc damage is +25%.
short_description: Consuming Voltage makes the target Conductive for 5 seconds. Arcs deal 25% more damage.

name: Thunderhead
description: Every 3rd full Voltage release calls a lightning strike for 100% damage.
short_description: Every third full Voltage release calls lightning for 100% damage.

name: Feedback
description: Electric kills refund 2 Voltage per stack.
short_description: Electric kills restore 2 Voltage for each stack.

name: Static Shield
description: Consuming Voltage grants 10 Barrier.
short_description: Consuming Voltage grants 10 Barrier.

name: Grid Link
description: While Voltage exceeds 5, current drone module efficiency is +35%.
short_description: Above 5 Voltage, current drone module efficiency is 35% higher.

name: Fury Engine
description: Gain 1 extra Fury per stack on hit, up to 4 Fury per hit.
short_description: Gain 1 extra Fury per stack on hit, up to 4 per hit.

name: Open Wound
description: Consuming Fury applies 3 Bleed stacks.
short_description: Consuming Fury applies 3 Bleed stacks.

name: Avatar of War
description: After consuming full Fury, gain +40% melee damage and -20% damage taken for 6 seconds.
short_description: After full Fury, deal 40% more melee damage and take 20% less damage for 6 seconds.

name: Guard Breaker
description: Heavy hits add 2 seconds of Vulnerable per stack, up to 6 seconds.
short_description: Heavy hits extend Vulnerable by 2 seconds per stack, up to 6 seconds.

name: Blood Temper
description: When a bleeding enemy dies, restore 5 health, capped at 15 per event.
short_description: When a bleeding enemy dies, restore 5 health, up to 15 each event.

name: Kinetic Return
description: Each enemy hit by a shockwave grants 1 Fury and 2 Barrier.
short_description: Each enemy hit by a shockwave grants 1 Fury and 2 Barrier.

name: Cartographer
description: Objectives always show direction and distance; interaction speed is +15%.
short_description: Objectives show direction and distance. Interactions are 15% faster.

name: Final Objective Boost
description: The final objective on each floor takes +50% damage; completion grants the team 20 Barrier.
short_description: The final objective takes 50% more damage. Completion grants the team 20 Barrier.

name: Relic Scanner
description: Each completed objective grants 4 gold per stack.
short_description: Each completed objective grants 4 gold for each stack.

name: Floor Memory
description: A deathless floor grants +4% damage on later floors, capped at +20%.
short_description: A deathless floor grants 4% more damage on later floors, up to 20%.

name: Wave Dividend
description: A wave completed without player deaths grants 8 gold to each player.
short_description: A deathless wave grants 8 gold to every player.

name: Endless Engine
description: Consecutive deathless waves grant +5% player and building damage, capped at +25%; a death resets it.
short_description: Deathless waves grant 5% more player and building damage, up to 25%. Death resets it.

name: Fortified Cycle
description: At wave start, repair every friendly building by 5% maximum durability per stack.
short_description: At wave start, repair friendly buildings by 5% maximum durability per stack.

name: Hold the Line
description: Inside the defense area, take 15% less damage and gain +25% drone efficiency.
short_description: Inside the defense area, take 15% less damage and gain 25% drone efficiency.

name: Courier
description: While carrying an objective item, move 10% faster and take 10% less damage.
short_description: While carrying an objective, move 10% faster and take 10% less damage.

name: Final Departure
description: After the exit opens, the team gains +30% damage and +15% speed, but health recovery stops.
short_description: When the exit opens, the team deals 30% more damage and moves 15% faster. Healing stops.

name: Signal Hacker
description: Switch and objective interactions are 10% faster per stack; total interaction bonus is capped at 60%.
short_description: Interactions are 10% faster per stack, up to 60%.

name: Clean Exit
description: Entering the evacuation zone restores 30% ammo and grants 20 Barrier once per evacuation.
short_description: Entering evacuation restores 30% ammo and grants 20 Barrier once.
